description: React component for the SQL Lab application interface in Apache Superset, including styling, event handling, and Redux integration.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React component managing the SQL Lab interface, including styling, event handling, and state management.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and disables side swipe navigation when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Checks local storage usage and logs warnings or events accordingly.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners and resets styles when component unmounts.

methods.name: onHashChanged
methods.description: Updates component state when URL hash changes.

methods.name: showLocalStorageUsageWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning toast about local storage usage and logs the event.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main SQL Lab interface or redirects based on URL hash.
